summaryCases.html:
Past 7 days

No outdoor or device sessions were logged in the past 7 days. We can’t tell whether you received little light or simply didn’t record it.

There are no logged sessions in the previous 7 days either.

If this reflects your week, a brief outdoor daylight break when practical can add a clear daytime signal. Ambient daylight is enough for the eyes; never stare at the sun.

Past 7 days

The past 7 days contain 1 outdoor session across 1 logged day.

The previous 7 days contain no logged sessions for comparison.

The records show exposure, not whether every light-responsive pathway received enough stimulation.

Past 7 days

The past 7 days contain 1 device session across 1 logged day.

The previous 7 days contain no logged sessions for comparison.

Devices supply targeted light. Outdoor daylight adds a wider spectrum and time-of-day context that a device does not copy.

Past 7 days

The past 7 days contain 2 outdoor sessions and 2 device sessions across 2 logged days.

Previous 7 days: 1 outdoor session and 0 device sessions.

Sunlight and device records stay separate; neither is added into a biological completion score.

Past 7 days

No outdoor or device sessions were logged in the past 7 days. We can’t tell whether you received little light or simply didn’t record it.

Previous 7 days: 2 outdoor sessions and 0 device sessions.

If this reflects your week, a brief outdoor daylight break when practical can add a clear daytime signal. Ambient daylight is enough for the eyes; never stare at the sun.
